# TopologicalEdgeStateRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of guiding optical signals along the boundaries of a topological photonic alloy, where propagation is immune to backscattering and defects. Provides lossless, defect-immune signal paths for on-chip optical interconnects, reducing energy overhead in TCC data movement.
